newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX rises with Wall Street after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: German DAX rises with Wall Street after U.S. data.

text.p: German shares advanced strongly in volatile afternoon electronic trade, boosted by lower-than-expected U.S. CPI data which led to a strong opening on the Dow Jones Industrial index on Wall Street.
The IBIS DAX index was up over two percent at 3,366.42 points, a rise of 68.90 points.

"The U.S. consumer prices data was encouraging but nobody should go mega-bullish on it. It was a relief to the nervousness which has been around since last Friday and there is support coming from the firm dollar and stronger Bunds," a share trader said.
